srep-0041-shadow-catcher.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<scene version="1.2">
<project width="640" height="360" fps="24" duration="1" background="#000000FF"/>
<output id="still" path="out/frame_%04d.png" codec="png-sequence"/>
<materials><material id="m-white" baseColor="#FFFFFFFF" roughness="1" specular="0"/></materials>
<composition>
<shape id="plate" shape="rect" width="640" height="360" x="0" y="0" fill="#808080FF"/>
<camera id="cam" projection="orthographic" orthoHeight="360" x="320" y="-200" z="150" pitch="-90"/>
<object3D id="floor" primitive="plane" width="600" height="300" rotationX="-90" material="m-white" shadowCatcher="true" x="320" y="300" z="150"/>
<object3D id="caster" primitive="box" width="40" height="20" depth="40" material="m-white" x="320" y="100" z="150"/>
</composition>
<lights><light id="key" type="spot" x="320" y="-100" z="150" pitch="-90" spotAngle="60" intensity="3" affectsSpecular="false" castShadow="true"/></lights>
</scene>

expected.rule: SREP 41 s3: geometry: light (320,-100,150) down, floor y=300 (400 px), caster top face y=90 half-width 20 -> shadow half-width 20*400/190 = 42.105 px: x 277.895..362.105, ortho camera 1 px/unit; no ambient so E_sh = 0, alpha = 1 inside (plate 128 -> 0); outside alpha = 0 (v=1, or E_un=0 beyond the cone): plate 128 unchanged. Strips 2 px inside and outside each edge

expected.rule: SREP 41 s2-4 with D11: geometry: light (320,-100,150) down, floor y=300 (400 px), caster top face y=90 half-width 20 -> shadow half-width 20*400/190 = 42.105 px: x 277.895..362.105, ortho camera 1 px/unit; ambient 0.18 white (A=0.18, D11: I*c_diff); spot E=3*(100/d)^2, L=(1-F0)*E*n.l with F0=0.04 (D11: pi*f*E*n.l, f=(1-F)c/pi), view and light along the normal; in shadow ratio=A/(A+L) ~ 0.50, C'=lin(128)*ratio, sRGB-encoded; per-region mean of the per-pixel values
